shortDesc.message: Use Cookie Blocker to remove annoying popups, auto reject cookies, or accept all cookies. The Blocker works on almost all websites.

storeDesc.message:
🚀 Cookie Blocker is a powerful cookies blocker designed to give you full control over your browsing experience. This extension automatically handles annoying banners, helping you block cookie popups and browse without interruptions. With this in chrome, you no longer have to waste time clicking buttons on every site you visit. 

​​This blocker builds on a base of i still don't care about cookies but takes it to the next level with advanced features that actually reject cookies. This makes Cookie Blocker  a superior extension for users who truly value their data and don’t want to waste their time finding where to click to close the consent pop-up.

Customize your experience with these easy options available in the settings menu:
1️⃣ Reject cookies automatically by default
2️⃣ Accept all cookies automatically by default
3️⃣ Add specific sites to a customizable whitelist
4️⃣ Report issues anonymously if the blocker fails

💎 Technical Excellence Meets User-Friendly Design
As a cookie notice blocker chrome extension, the blocker combines sophisticated detection algorithms with an intuitive interface. The blocker recognizes consent patterns across thousands of websites, automatically choosing the optimal strategy to stop cookies chrome popups while ensuring websites remain functional. This blocker works silently in the background, only appearing when you need to adjust settings or report an issue.

📥Installation and Setup 
Getting started with Cookie Blocker is simple:
1 Install the blocker from the Chrome Web Store
2 Automatically block cookie consent pop ups
3 (Optional) Choose your preferred consent mode

🔄 Have you found a website where cookies blocker needs an update to work perfectly? The reporting feature is there to help you and the community. Simply add the url to the whitelist in the cookie blocker menu and send an anonymous report using the same extension menu. The issue will be resolved quickly with the next release.

Follow these simple steps to use a report and improve Cookie Blocker experience for everyone:
➤ Open the blocker menu in your browser
➤ Add the problematic URL to the whitelist section
➤ Submit the anonymous report with a click
➤ Our team will fix it in the next release 
➤ Enjoy improved cookies extension 

Whether you are looking to block cookie pop ups chrome or simply want a blocker that works every time, this blocker is the answer you have been searching for. It surpasses the basic functionality of i don't care about cookies by offering real auto-rejection capabilities that protect you better.

Why prefer Cookie Blocker:
- Fast and lightweight design
- No data collection from users
- Compatible with all major sites
- Continuous improvements
- Just one click, and it works
- Effectively block cookie popups


Discover the benefits over other options:
• Better reject cookies instead of just hiding, or accept all cookies
• More comprehensive coverage for most of the consent warnings 
• User-friendly interface for extension management and customization
• Regular updates to keep up with new pop-ups and changes

The cookie blocking extension ensures that you can navigate the web without constant interruptions from consent forms that ask for accept all cookies or other options.

Perfect for:
▸ people that tired of constant consent banners
▸ users looking for a smarter cookies extension
▸ fans of i don't care about cookies who want more control

🌐 Download Cookie Blocker today and experience browsing the way it should be - clean, private, and uninterrupted. Your time and privacy are valuable. Stop wasting time on consent pop-ups and start enjoying a better web experience with our block cookies extension.

❓ Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
🤔 How is it different from other cookies blocker?
💡 Unlike other similar blockers, which mainly hide banners, this blocker actively rejects cookies when possible. This gives you stronger privacy protection instead of just a cleaner screen.

🤔 Does Cookie Blocker work on all websites?
💡 It supports thousands of popular sites and is updated regularly. If something doesn’t work, you can report the site directly from the blocker.

🤔 Does it really reject cookies automatically?
💡 Yes. The blocker automatically chooses the most privacy-friendly option, usually “reject all,” without requiring manual clicks. 

🤔 Is Cookie Blocker safe to use?
💡 Yes. The blocker does not collect or sell personal data, and reports are sent anonymously only to fix compatibility issues.
